title: HOC Basics
description: Understand higher-order components for logic reuse.

data.text: A **Higher-Order Component (HOC)** is a function that takes a component and returns a new component with additional props or behavior. It's a pattern for reusing component logic.

data.title: Basic HOC
Props Through HOC
Naming Convention
data.text: Prefix HOC names with 'with' (withAuth, withRouter) and set displayName for debugging.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: HOCs are functions that take and return components
They add behavior or props to existing components
Don't modify the original component - wrap it
